description.cmn_hans_cn: 获取大陆公募基金的管理费率和托管费率数据。可按基金代码、时间范围进行筛选，返回日期、管理费率（年）、管理费、托管费率（年）、托管费等数据。当用户想查询某公募基金的费用水平（管理费+托管费），辅助评估基金成本时，调用此接口。
description.en: Obtain management fee rate and custodian fee rate data for A-share funds. Filters can be applied by fund code and date range, returning fields such as date, annual management fee rate, management fee (in 10k CNY), annual custodian fee rate, and custodian fee (in 10k CNY). Call this interface when users want to query the fee level (management fee + custodian fee) of a fund or assess fund costs.
